entries.name: 可可蝠
entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT the attached approved Batwalk portrait into a UNIVERSAL ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET. The supplied portrait is the exact character model, not a loose style reference. Preserve its exact individual face, silhouette construction, body/ear proportions, colors, original accessories and pixel rendering. Do not redesign, smooth, squash or stretch the character.
Invariants for 可可蝠: Tall chocolate-brown wrapped-wing cocoon; huge thick caramel furry shawl collar framing small friendly brown face, short pink-lined ears, pug nose with two tiny lip wattles, blushing cheeks, tiny feet. Preserve the tall blanket body and fluffy collar, never a round generic bat.
Flight: unfold the same long chocolate cloak-wings from the shoulders, retaining the thick tan collar and tall small body. Never turn into a round generic bat.
Output transparent PNG, 4 columns × 5 rows of SQUARE equally spaced cells, 20 poses total, portrait aspect ratio 4:5 (ideally 2048×2560). Each row has four consecutive animation keyframes of ONE action. Use the same character scale, camera distance and centered body registration in every cell. Choose a scale small enough for open flying wings and tallest ears; then KEEP it across all five rows. Leave at least 12% empty transparent margin INSIDE EACH CELL. Nothing may touch cell borders or overlap neighboring cells. No grid lines, text, labels, letters, scenery, shadows, props except the tiny edible fruit, or other characters. Same Gentle pixel: clean stepped dark outlines, warm gentle colors, soft pixel-cluster shading, hard-edged pixels and actual alpha transparency.
ROW 1 IDLE: frame1 faithfully match the original resting portrait; frame2 a small attentive ear/eye glance; frame3 a soft blink and a little original wing-tip settling; frame4 settle back towards the original pose. Body proportions stay unchanged. A quiet loop, no jumping.
ROW 2 SLEEP: ALL FOUR frames show visibly closed sleepy eyes, with the same original wings gently wrapped/relaxed. frame1 calm sleep; frame2 tiny ear twitch; frame3 slightly lift then settle a wing tip while sleeping; frame4 relaxed sleep again. Do not use Z letters, pillows, hats not already in the reference, perches or branches. No full-body squashing/breathing deformation.
ROW 3 FLY: four clear phases of a wing beat using the TWO EXISTING wings: wings raised, extended out, lowered, extended again. Body remains centered at the SAME size, only a subtle lift. Keep original body, face, ears and accessories; do not replace its wings with a generic template or invent extra limbs. Whole wings fully fit within every cell.
ROW 4 PET: no human hand. frame1 original pose noticing a pat; frame2 leans head slightly into affection with happy closed eyes; frame3 existing wing tips/ears relax with one TINY peach heart beside head; frame4 contented original pose. Keep whole-body shape stable, no body stretch.
ROW 5 EAT: frame1 holds a tiny piece of fruit with its original wing/thumb at mouth; frame2 takes a bite; frame3 chews with pleased closed eyes; frame4 satisfied after swallowing. Use the reference fruit if present; otherwise a tiny red berry. Do not add arms/hands, change belly or enlarge cheeks. Fruit never covers the face.
Exactly two original wings and two original feet. Distinct motion in each row with a calm beginning/end. The neutral frame should feel like the original portrait simply came to life. Absolutely no new character design.

Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT the attached approved Batwalk portrait into a UNIVERSAL ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET. The supplied portrait is the exact character model, not a loose style reference. Preserve its exact individual face, silhouette construction, body/ear proportions, colors, original accessories and pixel rendering. Do not redesign, smooth, squash or stretch the character.
Invariants for 日蚀蝠: Compact pitch-black round hooded bat surrounded by large split golden ring-like wings, twin tall curved gold rims meeting above, tiny closed gold eyes and small gold line details, black feet. Preserve split hood-ring anatomy and tiny hidden face, not a separate solar disk or a new character.
Retain the black hooded round body with two thick split gold-ring wings and tiny gold feet. Flight flexes these original gold-edged ring wings without adding another pair. Face stays small and dark within the hood.
Output transparent PNG, 4 columns × 5 rows of SQUARE equally spaced cells, 20 poses total, portrait aspect ratio 4:5 (ideally 2048×2560). Each row has four consecutive animation keyframes of ONE action. Use the same character scale, camera distance and centered body registration in every cell. Choose a scale small enough for open flying wings and tallest ears; then KEEP it across all five rows. Leave at least 12% empty transparent margin INSIDE EACH CELL. Nothing may touch cell borders or overlap neighboring cells. No grid lines, text, labels, letters, scenery, shadows, props except the tiny edible fruit, or other characters. Same Gentle pixel: clean stepped dark outlines, warm gentle colors, soft pixel-cluster shading, hard-edged pixels and actual alpha transparency.
ROW 1 IDLE: frame1 faithfully match the original resting portrait; frame2 a small attentive ear/eye glance; frame3 a soft blink and a little original wing-tip settling; frame4 settle back towards the original pose. Body proportions stay unchanged. A quiet loop, no jumping.
ROW 2 SLEEP: ALL FOUR frames show visibly closed sleepy eyes, with the same original wings gently wrapped/relaxed. frame1 calm sleep; frame2 tiny ear twitch; frame3 slightly lift then settle a wing tip while sleeping; frame4 relaxed sleep again. Do not use Z letters, pillows, hats not already in the reference, perches or branches. No full-body squashing/breathing deformation.
ROW 3 FLY: four clear phases of a wing beat using the TWO EXISTING wings: wings raised, extended out, lowered, extended again. Body remains centered at the SAME size, only a subtle lift. Keep original body, face, ears and accessories; do not replace its wings with a generic template or invent extra limbs. Whole wings fully fit within every cell.
ROW 4 PET: no human hand. frame1 original pose noticing a pat; frame2 leans head slightly into affection with happy closed eyes; frame3 existing wing tips/ears relax with one TINY peach heart beside head; frame4 contented original pose. Keep whole-body shape stable, no body stretch.
ROW 5 EAT: frame1 holds a tiny piece of fruit with its original wing/thumb at mouth; frame2 takes a bite; frame3 chews with pleased closed eyes; frame4 satisfied after swallowing. Use the reference fruit if present; otherwise a tiny red berry. Do not add arms/hands, change belly or enlarge cheeks. Fruit never covers the face.
Exactly two original wings and two original feet. Distinct motion in each row with a calm beginning/end. The neutral frame should feel like the original portrait simply came to life. Absolutely no new character design.
Packing constraint: leave a generous clear transparent GUTTER between ALL neighboring sprites, including the flight row. The entire widest wing span may use at most 75% of a cell width. All tallest ear tips leave clear top and bottom gutters. Do not let any body/wing touch the outer image edge.
In flight, UNFOLD the existing wing pair. Do NOT retain two closed/folded wings on the belly AND add two spread wings behind them. Only two connected wings total.

Identity-preserving sprite edit of this exact approved Batwalk portrait. Make ONLY a FLY animation, 4 keyframes in a 2 by 2 grid on transparent PNG. Exact Gentle pixel face, colors, original anatomy and character personality from reference. The original has TWO olive-green wings folded across a yellow-green pear. To fly, unfold BOTH of these wings completely to the sides, leaving NO olive-green folded shape on the front of the pear/belly. The pear remains hugged between its original TWO orange FEET, tucked directly under the mouth; no added arms or hands. Keep its giant orange cheeks and small body.
Read-order poses: 1 wing tips raised; 2 wings extended sideways; 3 wing tips down; 4 sideways with subtle lift. SAME body/head scale and centered registration all 4 frames, no squash/stretch. ONLY original two wings articulate, no extra limbs. Each square cell has 18% transparent safety margin on EVERY SIDE, widest wings use <=64% of cell width, no cell overlaps, no cropping. Crisp stepped pixel outlines and pixel cluster shading. No labels, shadows, sparkles, scenery. The original character simply opens its own wings. Do not redesign.

Identity-preserving sprite edit of this exact approved Batwalk portrait. Make ONLY a FLY animation, 4 keyframes in a 2 by 2 grid on transparent PNG. Exact Gentle pixel face, colors, original anatomy and character personality from reference. The original chocolate cloak IS its TWO wings. To fly, unfold the crossed chocolate cloak fully, exposing a slim warm-brown furry belly below the huge tan ruff. The two panels that previously crossed the belly now extend sideways as the wings. There must be NO closed crossed cloak on its chest at the same time. Keep original big ruff, small face, long body proportions; do not shorten or squash its body.
Read-order poses: 1 wing tips raised; 2 wings extended sideways; 3 wing tips down; 4 sideways with subtle lift. SAME body/head scale and centered registration all 4 frames, no squash/stretch. ONLY original two wings articulate, no extra limbs. Each square cell has 18% transparent safety margin on EVERY SIDE, widest wings use <=64% of cell width, no cell overlaps, no cropping. Crisp stepped pixel outlines and pixel cluster shading. No labels, shadows, sparkles, scenery. The original character simply opens its own wings. Do not redesign.

Edit this exact Batwalk portrait into ONLY four flying keyframes, arranged 2 by 2 on a TRANSPARENT square sprite sheet. Same Gentle pixel art, exact approved character, same body proportions, face, colors, pixel clusters, stepped edges. Do not redesign. Keep this shy bat mostly wrapped in its purple cloak. It hovers by gently flexing ONLY the two existing outer cloak tips (up, out slightly, down, out slightly). Keep the whole narrow hood silhouette and tiny recessed face. No big open wing shape behind the hood, NO new wings on its back. There are ONLY the two original folded purple cloak panels, each flexes a little from the original portrait. The front flap can stay folded because the wings NEVER fully unfold. Avoid a wide spread-wing silhouette. Ear tip and tiny pink nose stay same.
Four squares in read order; SAME scale and registration across all frames. A very generous 20% transparent border inside every cell. Each entire pose MUST fit inside the middle 60% of its cell, including ALL wing tips. No overlaps. Four separate clean alpha sprites. No background, text, borders, or extra props.

Identity-preserving sprite edit of this exact approved Batwalk portrait. Make ONLY a FLY animation, 4 keyframes in a 2 by 2 grid on transparent PNG. Exact Gentle pixel face, colors, original anatomy and character personality from reference. The black/red cape IS its TWO wings. Completely unfold the front folded black wing into the viewer-left flight wing; the viewer-right raised cape wing opens as the other flight wing. The two purple-skinned golden-flesh fruit halves are each held at the original wing thumb tips, one at each side. NO folded wing or plum half remains over the front of the chest when flying. Keep thin black/red body and gray face. Exactly TWO wing-thumbs, TWO wings, TWO feet, no extra arms.
Read-order poses: 1 wing tips raised; 2 wings extended sideways; 3 wing tips down; 4 sideways with subtle lift. SAME body/head scale and centered registration all 4 frames, no squash/stretch. ONLY original two wings articulate, no extra limbs. Each square cell has 18% transparent safety margin on EVERY SIDE, widest wings use <=64% of cell width, no cell overlaps, no cropping. Crisp stepped pixel outlines and pixel cluster shading. No labels, shadows, sparkles, scenery. The original character simply opens its own wings. Do not redesign.

Edit this exact Batwalk portrait into ONLY four flying keyframes, arranged 2 by 2 on a TRANSPARENT square sprite sheet. Same Gentle pixel art, exact approved character, same body proportions, face, colors, pixel clusters, stepped edges. Do not redesign. Keep navy spiral galaxy belly with asymmetrical small face and huge lavender right ear. Only original TWO star-speckled side wings move (up, out, down, out). The oversized right ear never becomes a wing. Preserve size of belly, head, face and star pattern. No extra stars or decorative shapes, no aura or glow.
Four squares in read order; SAME scale and registration across all frames. A very generous 20% transparent border inside every cell. Each entire pose MUST fit inside the middle 60% of its cell, including ALL wing tips. No overlaps. Four separate clean alpha sprites. No background, text, borders, or extra props.
